plan: Second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values: the dominant strategy is to bid your true value. There’s no useful history (only 1 round), so assume others bid near their values. My value is 34, and bids are allowed in 0.1 increments, so bid 34 exactly. This wins when my value is highest and pays the second-highest bid, maximizing expected profit. Overbidding risks winning when it’s unprofitable; underbidding risks losing profitable wins. Tie-breaking is random; no adjustment improves expected payoff.
